config.source:
SELECT c.customer_name AS customer_name, SUM(f.net_revenue) AS customer_revenue
FROM scl.gold.fact_sales f
INNER JOIN scl.gold.dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
GROUP BY c.customer_name
ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT p.part_name AS part_name, SUM(f.net_revenue) AS part_revenue
FROM scl.gold.fact_sales f
INNER JOIN scl.gold.dim_product p ON f.part_key = p.part_key
GROUP BY p.part_name
ORDER BY part_revenue ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT p.part_name AS part_name, SUM(f.net_revenue) AS part_revenue
FROM scl.gold.fact_sales f
INNER JOIN scl.gold.dim_product p ON f.part_key = p.part_key
GROUP BY p.part_name
ORDER BY part_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT s.supplier_name AS supplier_name, SUM(f.net_revenue) AS supplier_revenue
FROM scl.gold.fact_sales f
INNER JOIN scl.gold.dim_supplier s ON f.supplier_key = s.supplier_key
GROUP BY s.supplier_name
ORDER BY supplier_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH supplier_revenue AS (
  SELECT f.supplier_key AS supplier_key, SUM(f.net_revenue) AS supplier_revenue
  FROM scl.gold.fact_sales f
  GROUP BY f.supplier_key
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT supplier_key, supplier_revenue,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY supplier_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank
  FROM supplier_revenue
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN revenue_rank <= 10 THEN 'Top 10 suppliers'
      WHEN revenue_rank <= 100 THEN 'Top 11-100 suppliers'
      ELSE 'Remaining suppliers'
    END AS supplier_tier,
    supplier_revenue AS tier_revenue
  FROM ranked
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT supplier_tier, SUM(tier_revenue) AS tier_revenue
  FROM tiered
  GROUP BY supplier_tier
)
SELECT supplier_tier, tier_revenue,
       tier_revenue / SUM(tier_revenue) OVER () AS tier_revenue_share
FROM grouped
